lead.topic: Top Gun: Maverick: the actors really went up in F/A-18 jets
lead.insight: The jet scenes in Top Gun: Maverick were shot in real F/A-18 Super Hornets. Tom Cruise built a flight course for the cast: a Cessna 172, then aerobatic planes, then a jet trainer, then the F/A-18. Navy pilots flew in the front seat; the actors sat behind. Six IMAX-quality Sony Venice cameras were fitted in the cockpit (four on the actor, two over the pilot's shoulder), and the actors took up to 8 G in some moves.
lead.why_now: Friday late night, big-screen mood; a true making-of story like the F1 reel. Not covered in the last 21 days.

screens.voice_tg: Tom Cruise avangalukkaaga oru payirchi thittame pottaar. Mudhalla chinna Cessna vimaanam. Aduthu thalaikeezhaa parakkara saagasa vimaanam. Appuram oru payirchi jet. Kadaisiyaa, Navy-yoda Super Hornet.

screens.voice: ஆனா ஜெட்டை ஓட்டினது நடிகர்கள் இல்ல. முன் சீட்ல நிஜ நேவி பைலட். பின் சீட்ல நடிகர். சில மூவ்ல, எட்டு G வரைக்கும் உடம்பு தாங்கணும்.
screens.voice_tg: Aanaa jet-ai ottinadhu nadigargal illa. Mun seat-la nija Navy pilot. Pin seat-la nadigar. Sila move-la, ettu G varaikkum udambu thaanganum.
